thought.title: CS_CHUNK=512 + Exp-based SiLU + Buffer Reuse → 2.18x speedup
thought.description: Enlarged CS_CHUNK from 64 to 512 (8x fewer loop iterations), replaced tanh-based sigmoid with Exp-based SiLU (Muls*-1+Exp+Adds+Div), reduced Cast operations from 3 to 2 per chunk by reusing w2 buffer in-place instead of copying up to separate x2Orig buffer.
thought.reason: Larger chunks improve vector unit amortization and reduce loop overhead. Exp has lower latency than Tanh on Ascend 910B. Buffer reuse eliminates redundant memory copies and a PipeBarrier.
thought.target_bottleneck: vector instruction count and loop overhead in element-wise compute

runtime.dsl_before: CS_CHUNK=64, tanh sigmoid (Muls*0.5+Tanh+Adds+Muls*0.5), Cast fp16→fp32 x3, 3 TBuf
runtime.dsl_after: CS_CHUNK=512, Exp SiLU (Muls*-1+Exp+Adds+Div), Cast fp16→fp32 x2, 3 TBuf with reuse
